_comment: DEV ONLY demo data for the integration hub (V-044). Start the server with VANILLA_INTEGRATIONS_FAKE=scripts/demo_integrations.json and switch GitHub import on in Options > Integrations: GitHub then answers from this file instead of gh or the network.

issues.title: Add a dark parchment theme for night shifts
issues.body: The bright parchment is hard on the eyes after dusk. A darker variant with the same gold accents would help.

issues.title: Export the guest book as CSV
issues.body: Innkeepers want to open the guest book in a spreadsheet. One row per guest, with arrival date and room.

prs.title: Speed up the nightly stock count
prs.body: Counts kegs in one pass instead of three. Needs a review of the rounding change in stock.rs.
